name: Gunnison River — Delta to Whitewater (Dominguez-Escalante NCA)
gaugeName: Gunnison River near Grand Junction, CO (USGS 09152500)
blurb: Class I–II desert canyon float through Dominguez-Escalante NCA; self-issued free overnight camping permits.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

notices.title: Use the river launch, not the lake ramp
notices.text: The Area marker is the city park location. Follow signs to the Gunnison River launch and confirm the actual entry during your shuttle. Overnight boaters starting in Delta must obtain the BLM camping permit at Escalante during the shuttle.

putInAccess.sourceName: City of Delta — Confluence Park Boat Launch (Delta)
putInAccess.note: The city lists separate river and lake ramps, and the BLM Gunnison guide confirms the river put-in at this address. The city facility record publishes this park coordinate. Imagery confirms the park parking area south of the Gunnison. A closer image candidate fell inside the Fort Uncompahgre grounds and was rejected. Retain the documented park-area coordinate rather than invent an exact river ramp.
putInAccess.directions: Enter Confluence Park at 440 North Palmer Street, Delta, and follow signs for the Gunnison River boat launch. The city marker is inland near the recreation parking. The park also has a separate lake ramp; identify the river launch during your shuttle.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 79609
takeOutAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 79609 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 31 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: BLM take-out off US 50 near the US 50/CO 141 junction; carry ~100 yards to parking. (BLM Dominguez-Escalante NCA Gunnison River overview / float guide, https://www.blm.gov/sites/blm.gov/files/gunnison_river_overview_v5.pdf).

sections.notes: Hail Mary Rapid ~1 mile below the launch. Overnight boaters self-issue a free camping permit. Mileage: BLM Dominguez-Escalante NCA Gunnison River overview / float guide.

putInAccess.sourceName: BLM Dominguez-Escalante NCA Gunnison River overview / float guide
putInAccess.note: Boating access is documented by BLM Dominguez-Escalante NCA Gunnison River overview / float guide: BLM; small craft only (kayaks/canoes) via trail under the railroad bridge; walking over the tracks is illegal (trespass). The coordinate is the agency's trailhead feature, not the launch itself; approximate. Imagery check 2026-10-26: Trailhead parking east of the railroad; consistent with an area point. Stays access-verified.
putInAccess.directions: End of Bridgeport Road off US 50. Carry boats on the narrow trail that passes under the railroad bridge to the river; launch may be inaccessible at high flows. Not suitable for rafts.
